data.text:
President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., joined by DOTr Secretary Giovanni Lopez, DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, SMC President and CEO Ramon Ang, and Toll Regulatory Board Executive Director Jose Arturo Tugade, led the inauguration of the new westbound off-ramp linking the NAIA Expressway to NAIA Terminal 3 in Pasay City on Friday, March 27.

The 320-meter access road is expected to improve entry to NAIA and help ease congestion along Andrews Avenue in Pasay City. Marcos said the project is part of broader government measures aimed at improving traffic flow ahead of the Holy Week travel period. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
